name: 12b_dspark_bf16
description: 12B Gemma4 dense DSpark, bf16 target+draft (no fp8). Diagnostic for the DSpark _project_context_kv F.linear crash: the fused K/V precompute path in gemma4_dspark.py reads k_proj.weight directly and cannot use Marlin-packed FP8 weights. Dropping quantization keeps k_proj.weight as a plain [512,3840] tensor so F.linear works. Same env/sampling/concurrency as 12b_dspark.
